steps.text: jei-pinyin-search: open the inventory so JEI's ingredient overlay is up (the harness's throwaway level is creative, so the inventory bind opens the creative inventory)
jei-pinyin-search: focus JEI's search bar through JEI's own bind (Ctrl+F by default)

jei-pinyin-search: 26.2's client drops the first character typed after JEI's search bar takes focus (measured 2026-10-18 on moderner-26.2-fabric: a bare 'shitou' left 'hitou' in the bar), so spend that one on a throwaway and clear the bar
jei-pinyin-search: type the pinyin of 石头 (shi tou) one character at a time
